## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new functionality or content

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows the naming convention (`feature/`, `bugfix/`, `docs/`, `experiment/`).
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] Content is properly attributed if it includes material from external sources.
- [ ] The PR targets the `main` branch.
